source_rows.candidate_corridor: Mumbai / Bhaucha Dhakka / Ferry Wharf ↔ Mandwa / Alibaug
usable_facts: Route selector supports Mumbai to Mandwa.
M2M describes Maharashtra's first Ro-Pax ferry, operational year-round including monsoons.
Official page states passenger fare from ₹400 onwards, motorcycle ₹210 onwards, 4 wheelers ₹1,020 onwards, bicycles ₹110 onwards, buses ₹4,500 onwards.
Official page lists Mumbai terminal at Ferry Wharf / Bhaucha Dhakka, Mumbai Port and Mandwa terminal at Mandwa Ropax Service Jetty.
source_rows.next_validation: Confirm current fare table via booking flow or downloadable tariff; collect passenger volumes/seasonality before model row.

source_rows.candidate_corridor: Kochi Water Metro terminals / harbour and backwater network
usable_facts: Official site reports Kochi as India's first city to have a Water Metro project.
Official site describes 75+ e-boats, 15 routes, 75+ kilometres.
Official site lists ridership update: 7,070,083 passengers joined us; daily update shown as 5,873 on 2026-06-19.
Official site lists terminals including South Chittoor, Cheranalloor, Eloor, Fort Kochi, Willingdon Island, Mattancherry, High Court, Kakkanad, Vytilla, and Vypin.
source_rows.next_validation: Scrape/confirm official fare chart or passes page; bind terminal-level route IDs before model row.
